appearance_facts.fact: Chart title reads 'Reservoir Surface Temperature Trend'.

appearance_facts.location: Main plot area, x-axis from 2005 to 2015
appearance_facts.fact: A single blue line connects black circular markers, showing a steady downward slope from the top-left (2005) to the bottom-right (2015).
The line starts at its highest vertical position, corresponding to the top of the y-axis scale near 24.
The line ends at its lowest vertical position, corresponding to the y-axis value of 10.
Each year from 2005 to 2015 has a labeled data point, and the vertical position decreases monotonically each year.
Vertical axis is labeled 'Surface temperature (°C)' with tick marks at 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, and 24.0°C.
Horizontal axis is labeled 'Year' with tick marks for every year from 2005 to 2015.
Specific temperature values are printed above each data point, starting at 24.0°C and ending at 10.0°C.
